intent: No test pinned to a frozen git ref/SHA (git diff <ref>..HEAD, --name-only, git show <sha>). Such tests can only rot once HEAD moves past the round — enforce scope via scripts/anti-scope-gate.sh during the round, not as a permanent product test.

Product tests must not read Anchor process state (coordination/). coordination/ is the pipeline's local working dir; product tests depend only on src/ + fixtures + coverage-matrices/. (Comment citations are fine — only code references count.)
